pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregularly shaped polygonal patches with softened vertices. Edge gradients are smooth with medium-brown pigmentation transitioning to cream-colored boundaries. Spatial area of patches is highest on the mid-neck and decreases toward the ventral region.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored negative space. Pathways are relatively thick with consistent pixel width. Junction nodes primarily feature tri-radiate intersections forming a stable grid-like topology across the neck and shoulder.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Jagged 1D silhouette visible against the sky background along the upper neck. The mane displays a high-frequency, low-amplitude serration composed of stiff, dark brown hair clusters.

other_distinctive_markers: Two Red-billed Oxpeckers (Buphagus erythrorhynchus) are visible perched on the upper dorsal neck, interacting with the mane and skin surface.
